title: baeckea crispiflora
intro: Baeckea crispiflora, commonly known as the 'Coastal Baeckea', is a flowering plant native to Australia. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating pain. The health benefits of Baeckea crispiflora include its potential to lower blood pressure and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
